prompt:
In the town of Oberwart, the oldest generation spoke:
		
Hungarian with survival skills German
 		
German with survival skills Hungarian
 		
German and Hungarian equally well (bilingual)
judge_reasoning: All candidates respond with speculative, non-evidenced interpretations rather than directly selecting among the three provided options. Candidate 4 is the most responsive in that it leans toward one of the options (bilingualism) rather than describing only a generic mix. Candidate 3 adds an apparently incorrect factual detail about Oberwart’s location (Upper Austria), which lowers its credibility. Candidates 1 and 2 are broadly similar but slightly less directly aligned than 4.
